notes.title: Mini Update!
notes.content:
Mini Update with some bug fixes, changes, and new content!

#Bugs fixed:

 Ring of Power's description showed wrong stats
 Mountains and trees without collision


#Changes made:

 Stone turtles' skill Heavy Jump now deals magical damage
 Skeletons and Zombies' Curse skill has been replaced with Terror skill
 Ice Fury spell - damage multiplier has been lowered from 115 to 85
 Ice Fury spell can deal critical damage now 


#New content:

 New legendary weapon - Crimson demon cane has been added 
 New enemy - Undead Mage has been added
